# Content coverage report

<!-- Generated by `npm run content:coverage`. Do not edit by hand. -->

> This report lists which tags the authored cases carry. **It is not a measure of coverage of the NCCPA PANCE blueprint or of any end-of-rotation blueprint.** The tags are author-proposed and unreviewed, and a handful of cases cannot represent a blueprint.

Package version 1.0.0, 5 scenarios. Tag provenance: author-proposed-unreviewed.

Vocabulary source: Organ-system and task-category IDs and labels follow the NCCPA PANCE content blueprint effective January 2025 (content/blueprints/nccpa-pance-2025.json, transcribed from the official PDF on 2026-10-11). Topic tags exist only so PAEA End of Rotation categories that have no PANCE equivalent can be crosswalked; each names its source category. Care-setting and age-group values are author-proposed. IDs are never deleted: retired IDs stay with status "deprecated" and replacedBy, so stored attempt snapshots keep resolving. Using a tag is not a claim of blueprint coverage.
